items.title: KillSec Ransomware Hits Brazilian Healthcare Software Provider
items.description: The ransomware gang breached a "major element" of the healthcare technology supply chain and stole sensitive patient data, according to researchers.

items.title: Google confirms hackers gained access to law enforcement portal
items.description: Google has confirmed that hackers created a fraudulent account in its Law Enforcement Request System (LERS) platform that law enforcement uses to submit official data requests to the company [...]

items.title: FBI Warns of Threat Actors Hitting Salesforce Customers
items.description: The FBI's IC3 recently warned of two threat actors, UNC6040 and UNC6395, targeting Salesforce customers, separately and in tandem.
